rows.en: Ymir: "I'm sorry to have put you to so much trouble."
Rest: "Not at all. But that machine earlier...
It didn't seem to be using its full power yet...
Just how much power does it have...?"
Fain: "Master!"
Rest: "Fain. Have you grown a little taller?"
Fain: "It's been more than half a year since then.
And my height isn't the only thing that's grown."
Rest: "Oh... You've learned to talk big.
I'd like to see how much your skills have improved,
but I have to report to His Majesty. We'll leave that for another time."
Fain: "Yes, sir!"
Miyasco: "...Rest..."
Rest: "I'm glad to see you looking well, too, Miyasco.
Are you all right physically?"
Miyasco: "Y-Yes. Um..."
Maki: "Rest!"
Rest: "Whoa! M-Maki! What are you doing...?"
Maki: "Reporting, of course!
I got a perfect recording of that battle, too."
Rest: "I-I see..."
Maki: "What about you, Rest? What brings you here?
Oh! Did you miss me?"
Rest: "Heh... You haven't changed.
We can say that's why, if you like, but I'm here in an official capacity.
Even if Liebhofen belongs to the Holy Land,
it engaged in combat near the capital.
It's my duty to investigate and report to His Majesty."
Maki: "Oh, how boring.
You haven't seen your girlfriend in ages, and you're so cold!
But that's part of what I love about you..."
Miyasco: "..."
Maki: "...Hey, do you know her?"
Rest: "Hm? Yes, I do. Is something wrong?"
Maki: "Hey, you. What's your relationship with Rest?"
Miyasco: "What?! O-Our relationship...?
He helped me a long time ago..."
Maki: "I see. And you fell for him.
But don't go stealing him."
Miyasco: "N-No, I wouldn't steal..."
Rest: "Now, now..."
Maki: "Well, you can't control
how someone else feels about a person.
And Rest's so handsome, I suppose it's only natural he's popular.
But he's mine now. There's no room for anyone
to come between us."
Sisk: "She's so confident..."
Rest: "...Maki, do you really trust me so little?"
Maki: "What? N-No, it's not..."
Rest: "Then stop taking it out on her.
I don't like seeing you act that way."
Maki: "Oh... I-I'm sorry..."
Rest: "You're apologizing to the wrong person."
Maki: "Um... I'm sorry.
I get aggressive so easily..."
Miyasco: "N-No, it's all right..."
Rest: "Well, I've heard the gist of what happened, and it's clear
you're not at fault. I'll report that to His Majesty,
and I promise to press your case with Parliament, too."
Ymir: "Thank you."
Rest: "Touya. I sense strong Prana in you.
But power that's too great can also draw you into darkness.
I hope you'll use that power for good...
Now, if you'll excuse me."
Maki: "Oh..."
Rest: "Ah, I forgot one thing."
Maki: "Ah, wait... Mm."
Miyasco: "!!"
Sisk: "Wow..."
Derock: "That's passionate. That's a grown-up kiss."
Maki: "Mmm... Oh, honestly..."
Rest: "I'm off, then."
Maki: "...Okay. Good luck..."
Touya: "...Your master's quite something, isn't he?"
Fain: "Heh heh, of course. Just like Lord Garyud,
he bears the title 'Sword Radiance.'
The only knight to study under Lady Marie Christil,
and effectively the head of Agarthia's Royal Knights,
as well as the strongest knight in the Kingdom of Agarthia.
That's my master! Well? Impressed?"
Touya: "What are you acting so proud for?"
Fain: "Master and student are one in spirit.
The master's honor is the student's honor!"
Touya: "I don't really follow that logic..."
Maki: "Well, back to work..."
Touya: "What are you planning this time?"
Maki: "Don't worry. As for your fight against ≪Ze=Ode≫,
I understand now that you're serious about it.
I'll just report the truth properly.
Being with you should land me some big scoops,
so I'll be counting on you from now on, too."
Baio: "So war's finally broken out. Heh heh, this is the perfect
opportunity... I'll be able to show off how magnificent my Bine Daga
really is...
Come on, Melissa! Get ready at once!!"
Melissa: "Y-Yes, Doctor... Ugh..."
Baio: "Hm? Wh-What's wrong, Melissa?!"
Melissa: "Ugh... I-I'm... all right..."
Baio: "Does your head hurt again? ...Would you like to lie down?
Oh, I know. Shall I bring you some medicine?
...No, something nourishing would be better... No, no..."
Melissa: "Th-Thank you, Doctor... I'm fine now.
I can go... You're going to sortie, aren't you?"
Baio: "Y-Yes, but...
you're the one who'll be piloting Bine Daga.
Will you be all right? If it's too much, we can put it off..."
Melissa: "You're so kind... Doctor..."
Melissa: "But I'm really all right. I'm fine now. See?"
Baio: "I-I see... Well, let's go!"
Melissa: "Yes, Doctor."
Clovis: "...It still won't move, huh.
Looks like two men won't work."
Leone: "Oh, so this is what Rayblade looks like inside."
Touya: "Hey, don't just come in here!"
Leone: "What's the harm? I'm not going to wear it out."
Touya: "That's not the point! Come on, we're getting out."
Ymir: "It looks like it only works with Touya and a female Pilot
together. What do you think, Celica?"
Celica: "..."
Ymir: "Celica?"
Celica: "Huh?! Oh, yes..."
Ai: "What's going on with you?
You've been acting strange ever since we got back."
Celica: "N-No... I... haven't..."
Ai: "...Why are you looking at Touya?
Hey, what did you do to Celica?"
Touya: "What?! Wh-What do you mean...? N-Nothing...
It's just, after I used up too much Prana, she..."
Ai: "Prana? Sure, that Prana earlier
was incredible, but..."
Ymir: "Celica, did you...?"
Celica: "W-Well, I have something to do!"
Clovis: "Hm? Wait a minute. Only you and women can ride Rayblade...
You're up to something, aren't you?"
Touya: "Wh-What? How should I know?
What the hell do you think I'd be doing, anyway?"
Kasumi: "It's strange..."
Arthur: "At any rate, we've confirmed it moves,
so from now on, Touya will sortie with either Ai, Kasumi, Aurelie or Celica
as his partner."
Fain: "That will mean one fewer Spirit Mech,
but considering Rayblade's performance, our fighting strength
shouldn't be a problem."
Ai: "That's a sensible opinion, coming from you."
Fain: "...What do you mean by that?!"
Ai: "Nothing."
Fain: "Hey! What's with that attitude?!"
Aurelie: "All right, that's enough, you two.
...Ai, what's wrong? I don't think much of that behavior."
Ai: "What? I just said what I thought."
Aurelie: "You can be irritated all you like,
but don't take it out on other people. They won't like you for it."
Ai: "Wh-When was I irritated?!
Don't act like you know everything!"
Aurelie: "Good grief. If only she'd be more honest with herself...
Right, Touya?"
Touya: "Why are you dragging me into this?"
Clovis: "Ha ha ha! Well, there's no point saying it to Touya.
Anyway, let's eat! Food!"
Fain: "Right. It's Sisk's turn today.
She's practically a professional cook. I'm looking forward to it."
Arthur: "Shall we go, then?"
Leone: "Hey, hey, you're pretty popular, aren't you?"
Touya: "Huh? Keep talking nonsense and I'll leave you behind."
Leone: "Oh, wait!
I want to eat, too!"
